page: Microsoft Azure E192s_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Esv7 family, powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 96 physical cores and 192 vCPUs running at 4.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, and a large 480 MB L3 cache. It does not include any local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, achieving top-tier status in both small-block cached and large-block uncached read and write operations. Single-core performance is moderate, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng single-core tests. The server excels in data-intensive tasks, demonstrating top-tier throughput in Redis SET operations, static web serving, and database operations.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high memory bandwidth, this instance is optimized for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching, and multi-threaded data processing. While it lacks local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, its advanced vector and matrix extensions support efficient CPU-based machine learning tasks, such as large language model prompt processing, which registers in the top tier of performance.
